# Busuu

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 20 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Language-learning marketing and signup flow: a purple #6e00f8-to-#116eee gradient hero under a simplified header, one green #11ee92 Learn-for-free pill, the #116eee action blue riding on text and 1px borders, 16px flag cards, an indigo #221658 paywall surface with #5438dc pill CTAs, and two served faces (Nista on marketing, NistaFonts on the app-shell pages).

Captured 2026-11-11, signed out (every captured surface is public; the product on app.busuu.com, register step 2+ and checkout sit behind login and were never reached). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Busuu's public surface — for building marketing, course-landing and signup-flow pages in the style of the real thing. It was read from **busuu.com** on **2026-11-11**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844: the home page, the /en/premium upsell (12-month and 1-month billing), the Spanish course landing page, the choose-your-language picker, register step 1, the login form and the about page.

Busuu is worth a capture because its language-learning marketing is a tight study in cheerful confidence: a purple `#6e00f8` → `#563ce9` → `#116eee` diagonal gradient hero under a simplified header, one green `#11ee92` `Learn for free` pill everywhere, a `#116eee` action blue that rides on text and 1px borders rather than fills, 16px flag cards that take the blue on hover, an indigo `#221658` paywall surface with `#5438dc` pill CTAs, and two served faces — Nista on marketing, NistaFonts on the app-shell pages. **Boundary:** the product itself lives on app.busuu.com behind login; register step 2 onward, checkout and every signed-in surface were never reached. Everything behind the login is a recorded gap, never inferred.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Two served faces do everything. **Nista** runs the marketing pages (home, about, premium, choose-your-language): the 40px hero headline, the 32px Premium title and its buttons, 16px body, 14px nav/footer. **NistaFonts** runs the app-shell surfaces (course, register, the language picker): the 48px course display and 16px picker labels. Both are served from the Busuu CDN; neither is distributed with the package — the style guide falls back to system sans.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Readings past a masked bot signal.** The committed screenshots and readings were taken with `navigator.webdriver` masked, the flag bot checks read to spot automation. The capture scripts no longer mask it (not run since), so a recapture may record a walled route as a boundary instead of a reading.
- **This is the public shell, not the app.** Lessons, review, streaks, the profile and all signed-in surfaces live on app.busuu.com behind login and are uncaptured. Treat the app's own design system as unknown.
- **One theme only.** The site paints light everywhere; the gradient hero and the indigo upsell are section styles. `tokens.json` ships no dark set.
- **The tokens are measured, not declared.** busuu.com compiles its styles (Sass + styled-components); almost no `:root` design vars exist. Every token cites the measurement it came from — that is the honest provenance.
- **The action blue has no fill.** `core.color.brand.blue` (#116eee) was measured on text and borders — picker-option labels, course-CTA text, the hover border on cards. The course CTA itself is a green `#11ee92` pill: its outer anchor computes transparent, its child `<button>` paints the green fill with a 100px radius on the course page's blue band.
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or the raw files.
- **Missing components.** `save-badge`, `m-menu-button` and `m-menu-open` are recorded missing in the measurement file: the kebab is an empty `<a>` with no text for the specs to name, and the SAVE n% badge selector found no match on the captured premium load. The opened menus show in [home-light-menu](screenshots/home-light-menu.png) and [mobile-home-light-menu](screenshots/mobile-home-light-menu.png). `nav-dropdown`, `period-toggle` and `language-item` have no captured focus look — a real keyboard focus could not be held on them.
- **`nav-dropdown` was read from the wrong element.** Its selector `.nav-dropdown` is also the class of the whole nav bar, so the reading is `nav.nav-dropdown`, the 1400 x 40 bar, not the dropdown panel (`div.main-nav-dropdown` with its `ul.main-nav-dropdown__list`, visible only while the menu is open). Needs a recapture; the script now targets the panel and records the entry missing when the menu is closed (not run since).

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do put ink on white.** `#252b2f` on a white field is the base; meta text runs `#666e7e`, hairlines `#d6dee6`. See [languages-light-default](screenshots/languages-light-default.png).
2. **Do spend the gradient on heroes.** The purple-to-blue diagonal (`#6e00f8` → `#563ce9` → `#116eee`) marks the home hero and the closing CTA band — and the indigo `#221658` owns the upsell. Body sections stay white. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
3. **Do pill every button.** Actions are pills: 45px radii on the green CTAs, 26px on the upsell buttons, the kebab menu's own rail. See [hero-cta](components/crops/hero-cta-default.png).
4. **Do reserve green for the one action.** `#11ee92` is `Learn for free` and nothing else; hover lifts to `#41f1a8`. Secondary actions go `#116eee` on white or ghost. See [cta-signup](components/crops/cta-signup-default.png).
5. **Do let the blue ride on borders and text.** The `#116eee` action blue marks picker-option labels, course-CTA text, the hover border on cards and focus rings — it is rarely a fill. See [language-item](components/crops/language-item-default.png).
6. **Don't add card chrome.** The picker option carries only a 1px `#dae1ea` hairline on a 16px radius, the plan card only a 2px white keyline on its indigo fill — no shadows, nothing heavier. On hover the option's hairline turns `#116eee` and its label takes a `#f3f8fe` fill. See [language-item](components/crops/language-item-hover.png).
7. **Don't style the app from this package.** Every value is the public surface's; app.busuu.com is uncaptured.
8. **Don't ship a dark theme.** None is offered; the indigo upsell is a section style, not a theme.
